_doc: Every test of the board-agnostic validation, defined once (tests/common/catalogue.py). Shield-specific tests live on the application branches.

tabs.title: Safety
tabs.question: Does the converter reach its safe state without relying on the CPU? CPU supervision, hardware trips and their declared fault reaction times (ADR 0009).
notes: On-target tests run on a bare Spin through an ST-Link: `tests/run_all.sh --l0 --target`, or the test's own `run.sh --run`. They reflash the board: flash env USB again before a bench session.

tests.title: Safety test harness failure before a reported criterion must fail the campaign
tests.criterion: Reported only when the build, the flash or the harness fails before its criteria.

tests.title: Arming connects the HRTIM system fault sources, enables the PVD, sets every fault state Inactive and starts the watchdog
tests.criterion: .a SYSCFG_CFGR2 CLL SPL PVDL ECCL = 1111; .b PVDE = 1; .c FAULT1 = FAULT2 = Inactive on timers A, C, D, E, F; .d watchdog timeout without a control task <= 1000 us over the LSI range
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: No false watchdog reset while the CPU is healthy
tests.criterion: .a no reset over 2 s with PWM on, fed by the kernel timer; .b no reset over 2 s fed by a 50 us control task
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: A slow control task lengthens the watchdog timeout instead of resetting the board
tests.criterion: .a timeout with a 2 ms control task >= 3 periods (6000 us); .b no reset over 1 s
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: A thread stack overflow disables every PWM output and latches the fault across the reset
tests.criterion: .a fatal error latched after the watchdog reset; .b reason K_ERR_STACK_CHK_FAIL; .c every switching PWM pin low after disabling; .d fault to outputs disabled <= 10 us; .e PWM refused while latched, clear refused with PWM on, accepted with PWM off, PWM back after clear
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: An undefined instruction disables every PWM output and latches the fault across the reset
tests.criterion: .a to .e as L0-SUP-04; reason K_ERR_CPU_EXCEPTION or K_ERR_ARM_USAGE_UNDEFINED_INSTRUCTION
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: A control task that never returns makes the watchdog reset the board; the fault is latched
tests.criterion: .a watchdog fault latched after the reset; .b PWM refused while latched, back after clear
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: Interrupts masked forever make the watchdog reset the board; the fault is latched
tests.criterion: .a, .b as L0-SUP-06
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: A Cortex-M4 lockup makes the watchdog reset the board; the HRTIM system fault turns the outputs off
tests.criterion: .a, .b as L0-SUP-06; .c every PWM pin low within 1 us of the lockup (scope on the PWM pins, BLOCKED until the SPOC bench)
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: A software reset keeps the latched fault; clearFault() clears it
tests.criterion: .a still latched after a software reset; .b cleared by clearFault()
tests.conditions: Bare Spin (no shield), MCUboot, ST-Link; env SAFETY_SUP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz, 50 %

tests.title: Allocation test harness failure before a reported criterion must fail the campaign
tests.criterion: Reported only when the allocation scripts fail before their criteria.

tests.title: A current on a comparator pin gets a comparator on its high bound and an ADC-watchdog window on its low bound
tests.criterion: .a paths comparator high, watchdog low; .b PA1: COMP1 -> FLT4, ADC1 AWD1 -> FLT1; .c DAC code and watchdog counts from the sensor gain and offset
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: A comparator shared by two pins (COMP3: PA0, PC1) serves only one limit
tests.criterion: only the higher-priority limit gets COMP3
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: A fault input taken by a comparator is not given to the ADC watchdog that shares it
tests.criterion: COMP1 on FLT4: ADC2 AWD1 (FLT4) not used
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: A limit with no free hardware channel stops the build unless the shield states an exception
tests.criterion: .a one error naming the limit and the fix; .b with an exception: software path, no error
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: protection = software uses no hardware channel
tests.criterion: no fault input used
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: priority decides which limit gets a scarce hardware channel
tests.criterion: the priority-1 limit gets the window first
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: comparator-bound = low puts the comparator on the low bound, inverted
tests.criterion: comparator on the low bound, polarity inverted
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: A non-linear sensor gets no comparator or watchdog threshold
tests.criterion: error unless an exception
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: A short-low or short-high leg needs a hardware trip on its own current, or a stated risk
tests.criterion: error without; ok with a trip or short-risk-accepted
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: A safe output not declared safe at reset gives a warning that explains why and how to fix it
tests.criterion: warning contains why it matters and the fix
tests.conditions: Synthetic boards on real Spin pins; pure Python, no hardware

tests.title: Every shield devicetree builds with the protection allocation in strict mode
tests.criterion: per shield: builds; every hardware limit covered or excepted
tests.conditions: Every zephyr/boards/shields/*/*.overlay, env SAFETY_CHECK, target idedata (devicetree + allocation, no compile)

tests.title: The committed protection tables match the build
tests.criterion: per shield: docs/safety/boards/<shield>.md identical to the generated table
tests.conditions: Same build as L0-ALC-11

tests.title: Comparator test harness failure before a reported criterion must fail the campaign
tests.criterion: Reported only when the build, the flash or the harness fails before its criteria.

tests.title: Each allocated comparator trip is armed, self-tested and locked before the first PWM output
tests.criterion: .a armed on the allocated fault inputs; .b/.c comparator enabled, locked, inputs as allocated, DAC threshold; .d fault inputs active high, internal source, 282 ns filter, locked; .e every timer listens, FLTLCK; .f fault interrupt enabled
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: Writes to the locked comparator and fault registers change nothing
tests.criterion: COMP1/COMP3 CSR, FLTINR1/2 and every FLTxR kept
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: I1_LOW beyond its limit turns every PWM output off in hardware within the declared time
tests.criterion: .a fault flag; .b comparator output to HRTIM fault flag <= 0.5 us; .c every PWM pin at its leg's safe state; .d latched, PWM refused; .e clear refused while beyond the limit, accepted once back, PWM back; .f INFO pin step to fault flag (includes the stimulus)
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: I2_LOW beyond its limit turns every PWM output off in hardware within the declared time
tests.criterion: .a to .f as L0-CMP-03; .f INFO pin step to fault flag (includes the stimulus)
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: A threshold written behind the Safety API trips within one control period
tests.criterion: .a latched, read-back detail, outputs off; .b clear once restored
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: setTripThreshold tightens a threshold and refuses to loosen it
tests.criterion: tighten to 5 A: DAC 3000; 6 A refused
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: A trip stays latched across a software reset
tests.criterion: latched, PWM refused, cleared, PWM back
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (I1_LOW on COMP1, I2_LOW on COMP3, 7 A = DAC 3400); env SAFETY_COMP; PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: Each allocated ADC-watchdog trip is configured on data acquisition's own conversions, self-tested and locked
tests.criterion: .a overrun mode overwrite, hardware trigger; .b/.c watchdog channels and windows as allocated (voltage low side open); .d external events sourced by the watchdogs; .e fault inputs on the external events, locked; .f data acquisition started by the Safety API with the watched channels, self-tests passed; .g all fault inputs armed
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay (current low limits -11 A, so floating pins sit inside the windows); env SAFETY_COMP; data acquisition started by the Safety API

tests.title: A reading outside an ADC-watchdog window turns every PWM output off in hardware
tests.criterion: .a fault flag; .b ADC restart to fault flag <= 60 us; .c every PWM pin at its leg's safe state; .d latched, refused, clear refused while outside, accepted once inside, PWM back
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay (current low limits -11 A, so floating pins sit inside the windows); env SAFETY_COMP; data acquisition started by the Safety API

tests.title: Each leg's safe state comes from the devicetree and is fixed before its timer runs
tests.criterion: .a LEG1 open, LEG2 short-low (low-side output active in fault); .b one safe output, two legs; setSafeState refused once armed
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay: LEG2 safe-state short-low, a safe output on Spin pin 21 (PB9), repeat-clear window 100 ms; env SAFETY_COMP

tests.title: After a hardware trip every leg is in its own safe state
tests.criterion: comparator and watchdog trips: LEG2 low side on, every other switch off
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay: LEG2 safe-state short-low, a safe output on Spin pin 21 (PB9), repeat-clear window 100 ms; env SAFETY_COMP

tests.title: Safe outputs drop to their safe level on any trip
tests.criterion: comparator trip, watchdog trip, threshold read-back
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay: LEG2 safe-state short-low, a safe output on Spin pin 21 (PB9), repeat-clear window 100 ms; env SAFETY_COMP

tests.title: A fault found by software stops through a real hardware fault, so short safe states hold
tests.criterion: read-back fault: LEG2 shorted, path external event
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay: LEG2 safe-state short-low, a safe output on Spin pin 21 (PB9), repeat-clear window 100 ms; env SAFETY_COMP

tests.title: The fault description names the sensor, bound and path
tests.criterion: "I1_LOW high limit (COMP1->FLT4)"
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay: LEG2 safe-state short-low, a safe output on Spin pin 21 (PB9), repeat-clear window 100 ms; env SAFETY_COMP

tests.title: A second fault soon after a clear needs a reboot
tests.criterion: clear 0, then -2, still -2
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree and a test overlay: LEG2 safe-state short-low, a safe output on Spin pin 21 (PB9), repeat-clear window 100 ms; env SAFETY_COMP

tests.title: Start-up Class B self-tests pass: CPU registers, RAM, flash reference, clock, VREFINT
tests.criterion: .a all five passed; .b INFO durations and coverage; .c clock against the LSI within its range; .d VREF+ within 3 % of the VREFBUF
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: Run-time self-tests run in slices
tests.criterion: .a CPU, RAM and flash passes, clock checks; .b INFO longest slice
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: An injected RAM self-test failure latches, refuses the PWM and clears only with a reboot
tests.criterion: fault SELFTEST/RAM, refused, clear -2, clean after reboot
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: An injected flash CRC failure latches, refuses the PWM and clears only with a reboot
tests.criterion: as L0-STK-03, detail flash
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: An injected clock failure latches, refuses the PWM and clears only with a reboot
tests.criterion: as L0-STK-03, detail clock
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: An injected CPU register failure latches, refuses the PWM and clears only with a reboot
tests.criterion: as L0-STK-03, detail CPU
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: A skipped program-flow checkpoint lets the watchdog reset the MCU
tests.criterion: reset, watchdog fault latched, PWM refused
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: Control interrupts far more frequent than declared are caught
tests.criterion: fault SELFTEST/IRQ_RATE, refused, clear -2
tests.conditions: Bare Spin, no shield, env SAFETY_SUP with CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_TEST_HOOKS (fault injection)

tests.title: A frozen current reading with the PWM on is caught
tests.criterion: fault SELFTEST/FROZEN after 2000 periods (acquisition started with dispatch)
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (floating current pins), env SAFETY_COMP; acquisition started by the scheduler before the first PWM output

tests.title: One Safety API test harness failure before a reported criterion must fail the campaign
tests.criterion: Reported only when a build, a flash or the harness fails before its criteria.

tests.title: Development-only calls do not compile in a production build
tests.criterion: .a safety.disarm() without development mode fails to build, with the message naming safety-mode; .b the same source builds in development mode; .c CONFIG_OWNTECH_SAFETY_RUNTIME_SELFTEST=n without development mode fails to build
tests.conditions: Twist 1.4.1 devicetree, env SAFETY_MODE, no board

tests.title: setChannelReaction() sets the safe state of every leg, applied by the HRTIM
tests.criterion: .a Open_Circuit: both outputs of each leg inactive on a fault; .b Short_Circuit before the PWM: low side active on each leg, timers without a leg off; .c refused once the PWM is initialised, fault state kept
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (V_HIGH 10..100, V1_LOW/V2_LOW -10..70, current low limits -11 A); envs SAFETY_API (production) and SAFETY_API_DEV (development mode); control task 100 us, PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: Software thresholds can be tightened, never loosened beyond the devicetree
tests.criterion: .a max looser refused (-2), tighter accepted; .b all or nothing over a list; .c same for min; .d bad sensor or count refused, a sensor with no board limit accepts any value
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (V_HIGH 10..100, V1_LOW/V2_LOW -10..70, current low limits -11 A); envs SAFETY_API (production) and SAFETY_API_DEV (development mode); control task 100 us, PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: NVS thresholds are accepted only when tighter than the devicetree
tests.criterion: .a looser stored values ignored (-5), devicetree value kept; .b tighter stored values retrieved; .c the board's own NVS entry restored after the test
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (V_HIGH 10..100, V1_LOW/V2_LOW -10..70, current low limits -11 A); envs SAFETY_API (production) and SAFETY_API_DEV (development mode); control task 100 us, PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: The software check reacts like every other trip (production build)
tests.criterion: .a software limit tightened; .b TRIP latched with sensor, bound and reading; .c stopped through a forced HRTIM fault, safe output dropped; .d PWM refused while latched, clear, PWM back; .e readable text with how to clear; .f within 5 control periods (+2); .g disableSafetyApi() ignored; .h a trip while the PWM is starting leaves no output on
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (V_HIGH 10..100, V1_LOW/V2_LOW -10..70, current low limits -11 A); envs SAFETY_API (production) and SAFETY_API_DEV (development mode); control task 100 us, PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz

tests.title: Development mode: reported, disarm() works, software limits may be loosened, the software check may be disabled
tests.criterion: .a production reports production; .b development reports it (flag, isDevelopmentMode); .c disarm() before the PWM: trips unarmed, CPU supervision armed; .d looser software thresholds accepted; .e looser NVS values retrieved; .f disableSafetyApi() holds the check off; .g.* the software check then reacts as in L0-API-05
tests.conditions: Bare Spin with the Twist 1.4.1 devicetree (V_HIGH 10..100, V1_LOW/V2_LOW -10..70, current low limits -11 A); envs SAFETY_API (production) and SAFETY_API_DEV (development mode); control task 100 us, PWM A, C, D, E, F at 200 kHz
